source: 661 “Reconnaissance Tools”
target: 661 “Instrumenta Exploratoria”

source: During lunch, Lumian used the excuse of going to the washroom to make his way to Hisoka Twanaku’s tawny house.
target: Durante prandio, Lumian excusatione ad latrinam eundum utens viam cepit ad domum fulvam Hisokae Twanaku.

source: After ascending the wooden stairs and passing through the empty, open ground floor, he took out a new wire and picked the lock on the door.
target: Postquam scalae ligneae ascendit et per planum imum vacuum atque apertum transiit, novum filum extraxit et seram ianuae per astutiam aperuit.

source: This level was completely open-air, leaving only support pillars.
target: Hic planus omnino sub caelo aperto erat, reliquis solis columnis sustentantibus.

source: At a glance, it was very spacious and simple.
target: Uno intuitu, amplus et simplex videbatur.

source: Stepping onto the wooden floor, Lumian circled around but found signs that no one had lived here for a long time.
target: In ligno pavimento ingrediens, Lumian circumambulavit, sed signa invenit quod nemo diu hic habitaverat.

source: He found nothing worth further investigating.
target: Nihil invenit quod ulteriori exploranda esset.

source: Suddenly, a voice came from behind him.
target: Subito vox ex tergo eius venit.

source: “What’s the problem here?”
target: “Quid hic accidit?”

source: The voice belonged to Camus Castiya.
target: Vox Camus Castiyae erat.

source: When he saw Lumian enter Twanaku’s rebuilt house from the dining room window, he found an excuse to leave the table and hurry over.
target: Cum videret Lumian per fenestram triclinarii in domum restitutam Twanaku intrare, excusationem invenit ut mensam relinqueret atque properaret.

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all.
target: Lumian omnino non miratus est.

source: He looked around and said, “Nothing.”
target: Circumspiciens et dicens, “Nihil.”

source: As he spoke, he ascended the stairs to the third floor.
target: Dum loquebatur, scalae ad tertium planum ascendit.

source: Camus sighed silently and followed.
target: Camus silentio suspiravit et secutus est.

source: He felt his mentality had aged considerably when with Louis Berry, resembling someone Vice-Captain Reaza’s age.
target: Sensi mentem meam multum senescere, cum Louis Berry, qui aetate Vice-Capitanei Reaza videbatur, aderat.

source: “Oh, Mother Earth, I’m not even twenty-four years old!”
target: “O, Mater Terra, nondum vicesimum quartum annum natus sum!”

source: Although I arrived in Matani at eighteen and joined the patrol team, dealing with numerous Beyonder incidents, participating in dangerous battles, and accumulating extensive experience, I am still a young man—a laidback young man who doesn’t focus on appearances in daily life!
target: Quamquam Matani adveniens, annos duodeviginti habens et in turma custodiae se coniunxissem, casus plurimos Beyonder tractans, in proeliis periculosissimis participans atque amplam experientiam colligens, adhuc iuvenis sum—iuvenis tranquillus qui in vita cotidiana speciem non attendit!

source: With a solemn, vigilant mindset, Camus followed Lumian through the third-floor rooms twice, searching through all the items.
target: Mente solenne et vigilante, Camus duabus vice Lumian per cubicula tertii gradus secutus est, omnia quaerens.

source: “There’s nothing out of place.”
target: “Nihil extraneum est.”

source: After setting down a pen holder, Camus shared his assessment with Lumian.
target: Postquam receptaculum calami posuit, Camus aestimationem suam cum Lumiano communicavit.

source: Lumian hadn’t gained anything either.
target: Lumian quoque nihil adeptus erat.

source: After a moment’s contemplation, he responded, “Bring Kolobo here later and ask if there are any areas that make him uneasy, dangerous, or uncomfortable.”
target: Post breve meditatione respondit: “Posthac adduc Kolobo huc et interroga an aliqua loca sint quae eum anxium, periculosum, aut incommodum faciant.”

source: Having only collaborated once, he’s already adept at utilizing Kolobo’s uniqueness… Bringing Kolobo here… Why does it feel like a police officer asking a constable to bring a canine unit… Camus criticized inwardly and nodded.
target: Cum semel tantum collaboravisset, iam callide uti singularitate Kolobo didicerat… Kolobo huc adducere… Cur hoc instar videtur ut vigil praefectus constabulum petat ut unitas canina apponeretur… Camus intus reprehendit et annuit.

source: “Understood.”
target: “Intellectum.”

source: As Lumian surveyed his surroundings again, he thought, I’ll bring Ludwig over later and ask if he detects any fragrance of special ingredients.
target: Dum Lumian iterum ambitum contemplabatur, cogitavit: “Posthac Ludwig adducam et interroga, utrum aliquam odorem ingredientium specialium sentiat.”

source: Returning to the dining room with Camus, Lumian indulged in the Gwadar beverage, savoring the rich and intricate aroma of roasted beef, roasted chicken wings, roasted snake meat, roasted spiders, and roasted leeches…
target: Rediens ad triclinarium cum Camus, Lumian potum Gwadar degustavit, sapidum et intricatum odorem bubulae tostae, alarum gallinae tostarum, carnis anguis tostae, araneorum tostarum, et sanguisugarum tostarum percipiens…

source: After eating and drinking his fill, Lumian took Ludwig’s hand and led him to “Hisoka” Twanaku’s house.
target: Postquam abundanter edens et bibens satiatus est, Lumian manum Ludovigi prehendit et eum ad domum “Hisoka” Twanaku duxit.

source: Camus, Lugano, and Kolobo—who wore sunglasses and walked sideways like a crab—followed closely behind.
target: Camus, Lugano, et Kolobo—qui oculos solares gerebant et lateraliter ambulabant sicut cancer—prope secuti sunt.

source: After exploring every nook and cranny, Lumian looked at Ludwig and asked with a smile, “Is there anything edible here?”
target: Postquam omnem recessum exploravit, Lumian Ludovico respexit et subridente quaesivit: “Est-ne hic aliquid edibile?”

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludwig caput inclinavit.

source: “No.”
target: “Non.”

source: Lumian led the boy down to the second level and looked at Kolobo, who had suddenly turned his back to them, and Camus.
target: Lumian puerum ad secundum planum duxit et respexit ad Kolobo, qui subito tergo eorum versa erat, atque ad Camus.

source: “Do any of you sense anything unusual?”
target: “Numquid quisquam vestrum aliquid insolitum sentit?”

source: The thin Kolobo hesitated for a moment and said, “This house feels a little cold. It doesn’t sit well with me.”
target: Kolobo tenuis paulisper cunctatus est et dixit: “Haec domus paulum frigida mihi videtur; non mihi placet.”

source: “Where exactly?” Lumian inquired with a calm expression.
target: “Ubi exacte?” inquit Lumian vultu placido.

source: Kolobo replied succinctly, “Everywhere.”
target: Kolobo breviter respondit: “Ubique.”

source: There’s something wrong with the entire house and even this land?
target: Nonne in tota domo atque hac terra quidquam non congruum est?

source: Hisoka definitely didn’t rebuild his previous home for nostalgia.
target: Hisoka certe non refecit priorem domum ex desiderio praeteritorum.

source: He’s not the original owner of that body, so he probably doesn’t have much attachment to this place.
target: Non est originalis dominus illius corporis, ergo verisimiliter parum ad hunc locum adligitur.

source: He’s also a true Coldblooded… Lumian pondered for over ten seconds and said to Lugano, Camus, and the others, “Stay here and guard against any mishaps.”
target: Lumian per plus quam decem secundas meditatus est et ad Lugano, Camus, ceterosque dixit: “Manete hic et cavete ne quid eveniat.”

source: He returned to the third floor and lay on a wooden bed with traces of someone having slept in it.
target: Rediit ad tertium planum et in lecto ligneo iacebat, cuius vestigia aliquis dormiverat erant.

source: Large, black mosquitoes flew over with crackling sounds.
target: Magni nigri culices volitabant cum sonis crepitantibus.

source: However, in the flickering sparks, they were ignited one by one, turning into charred corpses that floated onto the bed.
target: Sed in scintillis micantibus singillatim accensi erant, facti cadavera exsiccata conversa quae in lecto levabantur.

source: Lumian quickly slipped into a deep slumber.
target: Lumian celeriter in profundum somnum cecidit.

source: In his daze, he slowly awoke.
target: In stupefactu, lente evigilavit.

source: Pa! Lumian took out the golden pocket watch from Salle de Bal Brisé, opened it, and muttered to himself, “Slept for half an hour and didn’t have any special dreams…”
target: Pa! Lumian horologium aureum de Salle de Bal Brisé extraxit, aperuit, et sibi submurmuravit: “Dimidio horae dormivi neque somnia specialia habui…”

source: He had always believed the Dream Festival was related to dreams, so he deliberately slept in Hisoka’s house, but nothing happened.
target: Semper credebat Festum Somniorum cum somniis coniunctum esse, itaque proposito in domo Hisoka dormivit, sed nihil evenit.

source: Lumian gazed at the midday sun shining through the window and stood up thoughtfully.
target: Lumian solem meridianum per fenestram fulgentem intueri et, cogitans, surrexit.

source: Could the timing be off?
target: Num tempus inordinatum sit?

source: Must I sleep at a specific time and place to participate in the Dream Festival?
target: Oportetne mihi in certo tempore et loco dormire ut in Festo Somniorum participem?

source: Therefore, most Tizamo Town residents are unaware of its existence…
target: Ergo, plerisque in oppido Tizamo eius existentiam nesciunt…

source: When Lumian returned to the spacious but crude second level, he realized Camus and the others now had three more people with them.
target: Cum Lumian ad spatiosum sed rudimentarium secundum planum rediret, animadvertit Camus et ceteros nunc tres alios cum se teneri.

source: One was a man in his thirties with a painted face.
target: Unus vir, in annis tricesimalibus, facie picta, erat.

source: His light brown skin and thick lips gave him a relatively clean-cut look, and his black hair fell to his shoulders.
target: Cutis eius fulva et labia crassa ei aspectum purum dederunt, et capilli nigri ad umeros cadebant.

source: A strong pungent smell wafted from him.
target: Odor fortis et acre ex eo emanabat.

source: The other was a young woman wearing dark leather armor.
target: Altera erat iuvenis femina, quae loricam ex coriacea obscura gerebat.

source: Her brown hair was tied in two strands draped over her shoulders.
target: Capilli eius fusci in duas fascias ligati erant, quae super umeros eius pendebant.

source: Her light brown skin and facial features exuded a wild beauty.
target: Cutis eius fulva et lineamenta faciei feram venustatem efferebant.

source: She carried a hunting bow and a leather quiver of arrows on her back.
target: Gerebat arcum venatorium et fistulam sagittarum ex coriacea in dorso suo.

source: Another man, dressed similarly to Camus and the others in a shirt and thin pants, stood over 1.9 meters tall with an appearance leaning towards the Feysac Empire.
target: Alter vir, vestitus similiter ac Camus et ceteri in tunica et braccis tenuibus, plus quam 1.9 metra altus stetit, aspectu ad Imperium Feysac inclinato.

source: He had short light-blond hair, light-blue eyes, and a face bearing signs of exposure to sun and rain.
target: Capilli eius breves erant, flavi et clari, oculi caerulei erant, et facies vestigia sole atque pluvia patens ostendebat.

source: “They’re our colleagues, members of the Tizamo Town patrol team,” Camus introduced.
target: “Sunt collegae nostri, membra turmae custodiae oppidi Tizamo,” inquit Camus.

source: He pointed at the man with the white paint pattern on his face and said, “Captain of the local patrol team, Maslow.”
target: Indicavit virum cui facies in albo picta erat et dixit: “Dux turmae custodiae localis, Maslow.”

source: “His teammate…”
target: “Socius eius…”

source: Camus turned to the wild-looking woman with a bow and arrows on her back and said, “Rhea.”
target: Camus ad feminam aspectu ferocissimo, quae arcum et sagittas in dorso gerebat, convertit et dixit: “Rhea.”

source: “Loban, used to be an adventurer.”
target: “Loban, olim advenator erat.”

source: He spoke in Intisian the entire time.
target: Totum tempus in Intisiana loquebatur.

source: Finally, Camus addressed the three local patrol team members, “This is the great adventurer, Louis Berry. The other two are his assistant and godson.”
target: Denique Camus tribus membris turmae custodiae localis allocutus est: “Hic est magnus advenator, Louis Berry. Reliqua duo sunt adiutor eius et filius spiritualis.”

source: “This is the great adventurer, Louis Berry.
target: “Hic est magnus advenator, Louis Berry.

source: “The other two are his assistant and godson.”
target: Reliqua duo sunt adiutor eius et filius spiritualis.”

source: “Great adventurer…” Maslow repeated the term and cast his gaze at Loban.
target: “Magnus advenator…” repetivit Maslow et Loban intuens.

source: Feysacian Loban shook his head, indicating he had never heard of him.
target: Loban Feysacius caput concussit, indicans se eum numquam audivisse.

source: Maslow averted his gaze and asked Lumian, “Are you here to hunt?”
target: Maslow oculos avertit et Lumiano quaesivit: “Venari hic vis?”

source: Tizamo Town had been a favorite hunting ground for Port Pylos’s gentry for decades.
target: Oppidum Tizamo per decennia favens erat venationi pro nobilibus Portus Pylos.

source: There was no shortage of residents proficient in Intisian, and the patrol team had language requirements to handle the gentry’s requests.
target: Numerus incolarum peritorum in Intisiana non defuit, et turma custodiae requisita linguistica habebat ad petitiones nobilitatis perficiendas.

source: Lumian responded with a smile, “Something like that.”
target: Lumian subridente respondit: “Aliquid simile.”

source: Hunting for Hisoka’s inheritance and hidden issues was also a form of hunting.
target: Venatio hereditatis Hisokae et quaestionum occultarum quoque genus venationis erat.

source: Seeing the skeptical expressions on Maslow and the others’ faces, Camus hurriedly explained, “Do you remember the telegram sent last night?”
target: Videns vultus scepticos Maslow et ceterorum, Camus festinanter explicavit: “Meministine telegraphum quod heri nocte missum est?”

source: “You mean…”
target: “Id est…”

source: With her hunting bow and arrows, Rhea couldn’t help but glance at Lumian again.
target: Rhea, arcum venatorium et sagittas gerens, non potuit quin iterum Lumian intueretur.

source: Clearly, she, Maslow, and company had just arrived and hadn’t had time to discuss the detailed situation with Camus and Kolobo.
target: Manifestum est eam, Maslow, et socios modo advenisse et nondum tempus habuisse ut de re subtili cum Camus et Kolobo dissererent.

source: A telegram could only convey limited information.
target: Telegramma tantum informationem limitatam tradere potuit.

source: Camus nodded solemnly.
target: Camus solenne annuit.

source: “Monsieur Louis Berry is here to investigate the hidden issues behind Twanaku.”
target: “Dominus Louis Berry hic est ad quaestiones occultas post Twanaku investigandas.”

source: Using the excuse of inspecting the house again, he led the three local patrol team members upstairs.
target: Uti excusatione domum iterum inspiciendi, tres membra turmae custodiae localis ad superiora duxit.

source: Lugano glanced at the stairs and asked Kolobo, who had his back to them, “There’s a local patrol team in Tizamo?”
target: Lugano ad scalas respexit et Kolobo, qui tergo eorum versa erat, rogavit: “Estne turma custodiae localis in Tizamo?”

source: Based on his experience, there shouldn’t be any official Beyonder teams permanently stationed in the Northern Continent’s small towns and villages like Port Pylos.
target: Secundum experientiam suam, non debent esse turmas Beyonder officiales permanente statutae in oppidis et vicis Continenti Septentrionali, ut Portus Pylos.

source: They would typically send someone to handle issues as they arose.
target: Saepe mittent aliquem ad quaestiones, ut orirent, solvendas.

source: Kolobo turned his back to Lumian and Ludwig, trembling as he replied, “Most other towns don’t have them.”
target: Kolobo tergo Lumiano et Ludovico conversus, tremens respondit: “Pleraeque aliae oppida illa non habent.”

source: This place is rather special and is often attacked by primitive tribes.
target: Hic locus satis specialis est et saepe a tribubus primitivis oppugnatur.

source: Not only did our patrol team station a permanent team here, but the Admiral Guard also has Beyonders at the military camp outside town.
target: Non solum turma nostra hic team permanentem statuit, sed Praesidium Admiralis etiam Beyonderes in castris militaribus extra oppidum habet.

source: Lugano glanced at the strange official Beyonder who doubled as their carriage driver and couldn’t hide his curiosity.
target: Lugano respexit ad insolitum officialem Beyonder, qui etiam vectorem erat, et curiositatem suam celare non potuit.

source: “Why do you always have your back to us and wear black sunglasses?”
target: “Cur semper tergo nobis versus es et oculos solares nigros geris?”

source: “Don’t you want others to discover something’s wrong with your eyes?”
target: “Num non vis ut alii detegant aliquid de oculis tuis male esse?”

source: Kolobo fell silent, unsure if he should answer.
target: Kolobo siluit, nescius utrum respondere deberet.

source: At that moment, Camus led Maslow and the others back to the second floor.
target: Illo momento, Camus Maslow et ceteros ad planum secundum redegit.

source: When they looked at Lumian again, Maslow, Rhea, and Loban’s expressions turned much more serious.
target: Cum iterum Lumian intuebantur, vultus Maslow, Rhea, et Loban multo graviores facti sunt.

source: Lumian smiled and asked casually, “Did anything unusual happen with this house?”
target: Lumian subridente leviter quaesivit: “Acciditne aliquid insolitum cum hac domo?”

source: “No,” Maslow had already recalled the relevant details.
target: “Non,” respondit Maslow, iam memor rerum pertinentium erat.

source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “Were you transferred to Tizamo after the attack last year?”
target: Cum annuens, Lumian respondit: “Translati estis in Tizamo post impetus anni praeteriti?”

source: He recalled the dossier had mentioned the three Beyonders stationed here perished in the primitive tribe’s attack.
target: Meminuit dossier indicavisse tres Beyonderes hic stationatos in impetu tribus primitivarum perisse.

source: “Yes,” Loban, the former Feysacian adventurer, replied in a rough voice.
target: “Ita,” respondit Loban, olim Feysacius advenator, voce aspera.

source: “It’s been nearly a year.
target: “Fere unum annum praeteriit.

source: It’s been very peaceful here.
target: Hic valde pacatus fuit.

source: No more attacks.
target: Nulli impetus amplius.

source: According to the records, the tribe in the primitive forest attacked two to three times a year in past years… Admiral Querarill’s response of sending more guards and army deterred the primitive tribe from taking the risk.
target: Secundum tabulas, tribus in silva primitiva bis ad ter in annis praeteritis oppugnaverunt… Responsio Admiral Querarill, plures custodes et exercitum mittens, tribum primitivam ab periculo capiendum deterruit.

source: Did they really retreat into the forest depths?
target: Num vere in profunda silvae recesserunt?

source: Or did the April Fool’s prank cause something to change?
target: An Aprilis stultorum iocus quidquam mutavit?

source: Lumian sensed something amiss.
target: Lumian sensit aliquid male esse.

source: After conversing for a while, Lumian prepared to take Ludwig and Lugano to check into the motel.
target: Post aliquot verba, Lumian paravit ut Ludwig et Lugano ad deversorium ingrediendum duceret.

source: Maslow took a few steps forward and retrieved two items from a small leather bag hanging from his waist.
target: Maslow paucos gradus progrediens duo res ex parva sacculo coriaceo, a lumbis pendentem, extraxit.

source: There were brown candles and a glass bottle filled with a light-yellow liquid.
target: Erant candelae fuscae et lagena vitrea repleta liquore luteo pallido.

source: “Mosquito repellent candles and tranquil essential oil.
target: “Candelae repellentes culices et oleum essentiale tranquillum.

source: I hope you get a good night’s sleep,” Maslow said in accented Intisian.
target: “Spero ut bene quiescas nocte,” Maslow in Intisiana accentu dixit.

source: Camus chimed in, “What he means is that this place is close to the primitive forest, and mosquitoes and poisonous insects are everywhere.
target: Camus addidit: “Id quod dicit est, hic locus propinqui est silvae primitivae, atque culices et insecta venenata ubique sunt.

source: Although you’re Beyonders, it won’t be pleasant if you’re accidentally bitten.
target: Quamquam Beyonderes estis, non erit iucundum si fortuito morsus eritis.

source: Furthermore, you won’t be able to sleep peacefully and will keep waking up.
target: Praeterea, non potestis quiete dormire et assidue evigilabitis.

source: “The mosquito repellent candles are made from plants that mosquitoes dislike.
target: “Candelae repellentes culices ex plantis, quas culices odiscunt, factae sunt.

source: Tranquil essential oil comes from certain animals, making those damned buzzing fellows stay away from you.”
target: Oleum essentiale tranquillum ex quibusdam animalibus provenit, quod facit ut illi maledicti zumbantes a te recedant.”

source: At this point, Camus, Maslow, Rhea, and the others suddenly realized there were no mosquitoes on the entire second level.
target: Hoc tempore, Camus, Maslow, Rhea, et ceteri subito animadvertere nullos culices in toto plano secundo esse.

source: Lumian turned to Ludwig and accepted the candle and oil with a smile.
target: Lumian ad Ludwig se convertit et candela et oleum subridente accepit.

source: Then, he gently pinched his nose to confirm the pungent smell on Maslow and the others came from the tranquil essential oil.
target: Deinde, leniter nasum sibi premit ut confirmaret acrem odorem in Maslow et aliis a oleo essentiali tranquillum provenire.

source: After Lumian, Ludwig, and Lugano left Twanaku’s house, Maslow looked at Kolobo, who had his back to everyone, in confusion.
target: Postquam Lumian, Ludwig, et Lugano domum Twanaku reliquerunt, Maslow, confusus, Kolobo, qui tergo omnibus versa erat, intuebatur.

source: He asked in Dutanese, “What’s wrong?”
target: Interrogavit in Dutanensi: “Quid est incommode?”
